newsitem.title: USA: Alabama National to acquire First American.
newsitem.headline: Alabama National to acquire First American.

text.p: Alabama National BanCorp and First American Bancorp said on Friday they reached an agreement for Alabama National to acquire First American.
First American stockholders and option holders will receive 2,200,000 shares or options to purchase shares of Alabama National common stock in the aggregate, the companies said in a joint statement.
Alabama National shares closed at 23, up 1/2, on Friday.
Alabama National, the sixth largest bank holding company based in Alabama, reported total assets at June 30, 1997, of approximately $928 million. Alabama National operates 32 branches.

First American is the holding company for First American Bank, Corporate Billing, Inc., and First Allegiance Mortgage, Inc., all based in Decatur, Alabama. First American has seven branches located in Alabama and has $230 million in assets.
